description: List the ids of the transfer drafts this user sealed that are neither spent nor expired, newest first: draft_id, status, expires_at, and approval_session_id once the phone approval was requested (empty before). A draft whose approval was rejected stays listed with status APPROVAL_REQUESTED until it expires, so never open a second approval for it; read get_transfer_draft_outcome when the user asks how it ended. Use it when the draft or approval ids from earlier in the conversation are not in front of you; the newest draft is the one they just discussed. Set include_recently_closed when the user asks how a recent transfer ended and you hold no draft_id: recently_closed then lists this user's drafts from the last 24 hours that are being sent or are no longer open, newest first, each with its status (COMMITTED sent; COMMITTING being sent right now, never send again or call it failed; REFUSED, ABANDONED, EXPIRED not sent; APPROVAL_REQUESTED not sent yet, waiting for or confirming the phone approval). Moves no money.
name: list_open_transfer_drafts
title: List Open Mcp Transfer Drafts
